description: Reviewable LLM-director output. The director PLANS (may call a model); compile_scene_plan.py COMPILES deterministically — no network, no LLM at render time. Same plan + same assets -> same mp4.

notes.description: director's free-text rationale (optional, ignored by the compiler)

image.description: repo-relative path, resolved like other images

params.description: constructor kwargs for the slide type. Image-bearing values are repo-relative paths resolved against the assets dir (absolute paths rejected). RouteSlide accepts 'route' (a bundled route name like columbus_1492) instead of map_image+waypoints. VidSlide accepts 'src' (a finished clip under the assets dir, e.g. clips/pueblo-drift.mp4); the clip's duration must match duration_sec within 1s.

slide.description: one of the 20 slideforge slide types (case-insensitive)

turns.description: 0-based inclusive [first, last] script-turn indices this scene covers. Scenes must partition all turns contiguously (no gaps, no overlaps); the compiler enforces it.

title: APUSH slideforge scene plan
